jobs_results.job_title: Data Analyst Intern at Eicher Motors
jobs_results.description:
Eicher Motors is hiring a Data Analyst Intern in Pithampur. Eicher Motors is a OEM (commercial vehicles) and one of the most recognised names in the Indian automotive industry, and this internship places you inside a team that designs, builds and ships vehicles used by millions of people every day.

As a Data Analyst Intern at Eicher Motors Pithampur, you will work alongside experienced engineers and managers on live programmes rather than sample projects. You will spend time on the shop floor and in design reviews, learn how a product moves from concept to a road-ready vehicle, and take genuine ownership of a scoped piece of work.

What you will do:
• Support day-to-day data analyst work on active Eicher Motors programmes in Pithampur.
• Apply SQL, Advanced Excel, Power BI, Python to real problems, with review and mentorship from senior engineers.
• Collect and analyse data, document your findings and present them to the team.
• Work cross-functionally with design, manufacturing, quality and supply-chain colleagues.
• Follow safety, quality and compliance standards expected in automotive manufacturing.

Who should apply:
• Students and recent graduates in engineering or a related discipline.
• Working knowledge of SQL, Advanced Excel, Power BI — depth matters more than breadth.
• Curiosity about how vehicles are engineered and a willingness to learn on the floor.
• Strong communication and the discipline to document work clearly.

What you get: a monthly stipend of ₹30,000, a 12-month structured programme, mentorship from automotive professionals, and experience at Eicher Motors that carries real weight on an engineering CV.

If you want to build a career in the automobile industry in Pithampur, apply now — we would like to meet you. Responsibilities: Support data analyst work on live Eicher Motors programmes in Pithampur; Apply SQL, Advanced Excel, Power BI to real engineering problems; Analyse data, document findings and present them to the team; Collaborate with design, manufacturing, quality and supply-chain teams. Requirements: Working knowledge of SQL, Advanced Excel, Power BI, Python; Open to students and recent graduates; Interest in the automobile / mobility industry; Strong problem-solving, documentation and communication skills.

jobs_results.job_title: Data Analyst – AV Support Data Infrastructure & Analytics (Indore)
jobs_results.description:
Data Analyst - Autonomous Vehicle (AV) Operations & Infrastructure 

Role:  Data Analyst – AV Support Data Infrastructure & Analytics 

Experience:  4–6 Years 

Location:  Remote / Flexible 

Industry:  Global Tech & Mobility Leader 

About the Team & Opportunity 

Our team owns the end-to-end data foundation driving autonomous vehicle (AV) support operations for one of the world's leading mobility platforms. Every operational metric, real-time rider contact, automated data-quality check, and pre-launch feature instrumentation flows through the systems we architect. 

We sit directly at the intersection of AV Program Teams , Operational Analytics , and Core Data Engineering  to turn complex operational data into actionable, trustworthy insights. 

What You’ll Do 

- Redefine the Core Data Layer:  Transform organically grown data environments into a deliberate, clean "gold layer." Consolidate overlapping tables, optimize upstream join logic, and establish unified canonical datasets. 
- Deliver Business Analytics & Insights:  Partner with AV program leadership to scope ambiguous business challenges, define metrics, build dashboards, and answer high-impact operational questions. 
- Guide Instrumentation for New AV Products:  Review Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) across launch lifecycles to ensure proper event logging and telemetry are live before new features ship. 
- Maintain & Govern Data Infrastructure:  Monitor daily pipelines for freshness, accuracy, and volume. Build governance frameworks around SLAs, change-management workflows, and automated incident alerting. 
- Scale Real-Time Analytics:  Expand streaming feeds (Kafka/Flink/Pinot) to lower latency and power real-time operational notifications as incidents develop. 

What You’ll Need 

- 4–6 years  in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, or Data Engineering with a focus on dataset and pipeline ownership (not just query consumption). 
- Advanced SQL & Distributed Computing:  Hands-on experience building production transformations in Spark SQL  and Hive , authoring canonical patterns that other engineers build on. 
- Customer Support Data Expertise:  Hands-on familiarity with support operations metrics (contacts, tickets, handle time, CSAT) and the nuances of handling messy, multi-grained data. 
- Strong Stakeholder Communication:  Proven ability to scope vague business requests, push back when framing is off, and present transparent takeaways to non-technical partners. 
- AI Tool Integration:  Practical experience using AI/agentic coding platforms to accelerate pipeline, analysis, and dashboard development with high validation rigor. 

Preferred Qualifications 

- AV / Autonomous Systems Interest:  Understanding of or genuine curiosity about how autonomous trip operations and support models work. 
- Semantic & Metric Layers:  Experience with dbt, LookML, or proprietary metric management systems. 
- Streaming & Real-Time Analytics:  Familiarity with Kafka, Flink, Pinot, or real-time event processing. 
- Orchestration & Observability:  Hands-on experience with Airflow and data observability tools. 
- Dashboarding & Apps:  Proficiency with Tableau, Streamlit, Retool, or custom internal tool suites. 

Anam Chaudhry

jobs_results.title: Quantitative Data Analyst (Financial Markets)
jobs_results.description:
Role Overview


We are looking for a Data Analyst with a strong quantitative background to extract actionable insights from raw stock market data. In this role, you wont just be building dashboards; you will be digging into massive datasetsranging from tick-by-tick price data to fundamental corporate metricsusing statistics, inference, and machine learning.


The ideal candidate bridges the gap between data science and financial markets, possessing the coding rigor to clean messy financial data and the analytical mindset to discover market anomalies, alpha signals, or risk factors.


Key Responsibilities


Data Exploration & Engineering: Ingest, clean, and preprocess massive volumes of structured and unstructured financial data (e.g., price-volume series, order book data, corporate filings, macroeconomic indicators).
Statistical Modeling & Inference: Apply rigorous statistical methods (time-series analysis, regression models, hypothesis testing) to validate market hypotheses and identify historical anomalies.
Predictive Modeling: Design and prototype machine learning models to forecast market trends, price movements, or fundamental metrics.
Feature Engineering: Extract and engineer high-quality features from raw price actions and financial statements to feed into quantitative strategies.
Testing & Validation: Collaborate with stakeholders to test analytical insights and predictive models against historical data, ensuring robustness against overfitting.
Insight Delivery: Standardize data pipelines and translate complex quantitative findings into clear, data-driven recommendations for the broader team.
Required Skills & Qualifications


Python: Proficiency in Python is mandatory. Working knowledge of the core data science stack: pandas/polars, numpy, scipy, and scikit-learn required.
Database & SQL: Working knowledge of querying large relational databases and dealing with time-series databases (e.g., SQL, PostgreSQL, etc.).
Quantitative Foundation: Solid grasp of probability, statistical inference, linear algebra, and time-series econometrics.
Version Control: Clean Git hygiene and familiarity with collaborative workflows.
Compensation & Other Details


Stipend: 10,000  15,000 per month.
Work Mode: In-Office
Duration: 4 months.
PPO Opportunity based on Performance
Additional Perks: Free meals .

We're a small but mighty Amazon & TikTok growth agency with real momentum, and we're still small enough that every person on the team genuinely matters. No layers, no bureaucracy. Just a tight group of smart, fun people doing great work together.


Work directly with the founders. You'll work alongside the people who built this business from the ground up.A ringside seat to everything. You'll play a pivotal role in preparing for client conversations, the beating heart of this business, and get visibility into every corner of how we operate.Interesting & varied set of clients, across a diverse range of product categories with different contexts & challenges. No day will be same.Real ownership from day one. We're at that exciting stage where there's momentum and staying power, but still tons of room to build, create, and make your mark.If solving problems with a group of smart & fun individuals is what gets you out of bed every day, you will love it here.

You find a way throughBonus Points For...

No edits, no questionsKnow your way around Amazon and TikTok data like it's home turfHave built slick, reusable Excel models that make recurring reporting a breezeAre already flagging interesting trends and data stories before anyone asksHave become the go-to person the team leans on every time a client meeting is on the calendar
